summary: Minimum-viable T2: hand-rolled CQL v4 wire, STARTUP-vs-AUTHENTICATE discriminator, and a real SELECT ... FROM system.local read on unauth. Only two finding kinds. Big gap: no CVE-2021-44521 UDF probe (module claims it but never actually checks CREATE FUNCTION perm), no PasswordAuthenticator cred sweep, no auth_challenge follow-through, no keyspace enumeration.

findings.tier_evidence: STARTUP -> READY completes and SELECT release_version,cluster_name,data_center,partitioner FROM system.local returns real row bytes - proof of query access.
findings.promotion_notes: Add follow-on SELECT * FROM system_auth.roles (roles + salted_hash if PasswordAuthenticator is on but role table readable), SELECT keyspace_name FROM system_schema.keyspaces, and a UDF-permission read (SELECT permissions FROM system_auth.role_permissions WHERE resource LIKE 'functions%'). T3 comes from harvesting the bcrypt hashes for hashcat -m 3200.
findings.tester_next_step: cqlsh <ip> <port> -e 'SELECT * FROM system_schema.keyspaces' ; cqlsh <ip> <port> -e 'SELECT role,salted_hash,is_superuser FROM system_auth.roles' - the bcrypt hashes feed hashcat -m 3200.

findings.title_pattern: Apache Cassandra - UDF RCE / legacy build
findings.tier_evidence: release_version < 4.0.2 flagged; CVE-2021-44521 UDF path is only inferred from version, never actively probed.
findings.promotion_notes: T1: SELECT enable_user_defined_functions and enable_scripted_user_defined_functions from system_views.settings (4.0+) to positively confirm the surface is open. T2: on unauth+scripting-enabled, CREATE FUNCTION test with a JS body that emits a benign OOB DNS callback.
findings.tester_next_step: cqlsh <ip> <port> -e "SELECT * FROM system_views.settings WHERE name IN ('enable_user_defined_functions','enable_scripted_user_defined_functions') ALLOW FILTERING" ; if both true, PoC per Apache advisory CVE-2021-44521 (test-scope only).
